value.rationale: The 800-conic quartic is the unique extremal smooth quartic, making its weighted conic-intersection graph a canonical object. The two local profiles are a natural structural classification, not an arbitrary slice; they align nontrivially with the projective orbit decomposition and the residual plane-section involution. The quotient counts give reusable incidence data for automorphism and lattice calculations and go materially beyond merely re-enumerating the known 800 conics.
